d: To ensure that the procedures applied within both Aerodromes – Hamad and Doha International Airports remain compliant with Aerodrome Licensing requirements of Qatar Civil Aviation Regulations on Aerodromes. Will work covering the activity required by QCAA for the Aerodrome standards, ensuring that regulatory certification Specifications are met by MATAR organization and by other stakeholders involved in aerodrome operation guaranteeing compliance of aerodrome standards as per of QCAA requirements. The main purpose of the role is to ensure the Aerodrome Standards are applied by MATAR and other stakeholder's airside & flight procedures correspond to the QCAA requirement, including safety audits, inspections, and work orders in accordance with the airport directives, and relevant industry legislation as well as Aerodrome Certifications processes.
q: Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with minimum 4 years of job-related experience
Must have attended training course on “Safety Management System Implementation” from ICAO / ACI.
Must have attended training course on ICAO Annex 14.
Must have attended training course on “Apron Management” from ICAO / ACI.
Previous hands-on experience in aerodrome certification process.
Experience in documentation procedures drafting in aerodromes.
Experience in preparing/developing documents, manuals, and Standard Operating Procedures.
Ability to accurately translate complex policies into concise and comprehensive procedures.
Ability to maintain concentration and attention to detail, conduct and analyse audit reports, and provide feedback and recommendations.
Strong understanding of aerodrome licensing and renewal of aerodrome license.
Sound understanding of ICAO Annex 14, related ICAO Documents, and QCARs.
Ability to carry out airfield audits.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Excellent proficiency in using MS Office applications.
Attended training course on “Aerodrome Audit and Compliance” from a recognized training institute (e.g., ICAO / ACI) is a plus.
Master’s Degree holder is a plus.
r: Responsible for updating and constant reviewing of the department’s operational programs relating to Compliance Monitoring and the associated requirements.
Contact and liaise with Aerodrome Departments third party contractors and Airport Stakeholders, on matters relating to the Compliance Monitoring requirements.
Establishing, conducting and leading MATAR Compliance Audits and inspection to ensure safer operations and maintain the aerodrome compliant with national and international regulations.

Coordination and communication with stakeholders for MATAR compliance audits, deliver audit reports, review and communicate the acceptance of corrective action plans and monitor their implementations.

Implementing Aerodrome Compliance Monitoring System by applying specified procedures such as preparing audit programe, audit plan, pre-audit plan, perform actual audit and respective post audit activities for internal, external and third-party contractors audit, which are originating from Civil Aviation Regulations – QCAR.
Prepare, coordinate and follow-up on aerodrome continuous oversight inspections performed by QCAA Aerodrome standards directorate for renew aerodrome certification.

Develop the Compliance monitoring basis, by ensuring that all the required procedures and processes are properly documented in aerodrome manual for both aerodromes – DIA and HIA, and the respected standards operating procedures, following QCAR regulations and internal MATAR procedures in reference to the compliance functions.
Contribute to conduct of any training and promotion activity such as Safety Management System Training (SMS) and Airport Safety week Campaign.

Provide change management assessments connected with the changes within organization of airport stakeholders and third-party contractors, by leading roundtable and brainstorming sessions on areas related to compliance to ensure the change process is smooth and without creating any additional hazards.

Guiding airport stakeholders with all matters relating to Operational Licensing and Compliance of activities performed by them to ensure that their operations are in accordance with Civil Aviation requirements.

Manage the documents control processes for internal and external audits, by assigning proper name convention and reference number (with all attributes – departments, sections, type of document, etc) and ensure the required information are up to date.

Review and analyze the voluntary reports (concerning non-compliance with processes and procedures) and identify potential areas, where targeted (non-scheduled) audits are required within concerned areas of operations. Take appropriate actions and monitoring implementations of identified measures.

d: Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.
Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
$50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.
Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.
This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:
Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.
$50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

The Truck Mixer Driver is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of a concrete mixer truck for the delivery of ready-mix concrete to customer sites. The role ensures that deliveries are completed in accordance with company procedures, manufacturer's recommendations, quality standards, and all applicable traffic and safety regulations.
q: Valid Heavy Vehicle Driving License (Special Use License preferred)
Minimum 2 years of experience operating heavy vehicles, preferably truck mixers or construction-related equipment
Good knowledge of road safety regulations and defensive driving practices
Ability to perform daily vehicle inspections and report mechanical issues
Basic understanding of ready-mix concrete delivery operations
Ability to communicate effectively with customers, site personnel, and colleagues
Physically fit and capable of working in a demanding outdoor environment
Safety-conscious with strong awareness of operating heavy vehicles around personnel and construction activities
r: Operate the truck mixer in accordance with company procedures and manufacturer recommendations
Deliver ready-mix concrete to designated customer sites as identified on delivery tickets and instructed by the Batcher or Production Supervisor
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and ensure the truck mixer is maintained in accordance with company requirements
Drive safely and responsibly while complying with all traffic laws and regulations
Verify that adequate and safe access is available before entering and discharging concrete at customer sites
Safely discharge concrete according to customer requirements and company procedures
Liaise with customers, site representatives, and concrete pump operators to ensure efficient deliveries and excellent customer service
Maintain the cleanliness and appearance of the truck mixer, ensuring it remains free from excessive concrete buildup
Promptly report vehicle defects, mechanical faults, accidents, delays, or operational issues to the Batcher, Production Supervisor, and Workshop
Report customer complaints regarding concrete quality or supply to senior production staff
Complete delivery documentation accurately and maintain records as required
Follow instructions provided by supervisors and other authorized personnel
